_comment_mix: AI is OFF by default. 87 real photos is months of feed, and a generated picture invites a caption that claims a moment which never happened. Raise ai above 0 only if you accept that trade.
_comment_ig_user_id: Not a secret, just the Instagram Business Account id. Filled in by the whoami workflow. The IG_USER_ID env var overrides it.
_comment_heartbeat: 0 = the heartbeat expects a post TODAY. It runs at 21:00 UTC, after both posting windows and both catch-up runs, so nothing is still in flight. It was 2, which let a feed that died on Tuesday go unreported until the next Monday.
